# @family-hub/api-client

TypeScript client for the Family Hub API, generated by
[`@hey-api/openapi-ts`](https://heyapi.dev) from
[`docs/reference/openapi.json`](../../docs/reference/openapi.json).

**Do not edit `src/`.** Change the API, then run `make generate` from the
repository root. CI fails if the committed client is stale.

```ts
import { householdsGetHousehold } from "@family-hub/api-client";
import { client } from "@family-hub/api-client/client"; // shared instance: config, interceptors
```

Function names come from OpenAPI operation IDs, `<tag>_<function>` in
camel case: `auth_login` becomes `authLogin`.
